# Anima Volitiva — Managed B2B Coffee Infrastructure (Kyiv & Kyiv Oblast)

_Last updated: 2026-08-22 — lead form UI available; direct-contact fallback active until backend connection; bilingual EN/UA._

> Anima Volitiva provides fully-managed B2B coffee equipment rental and service for HoReCa, retail and corporate offices across Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast: Dr. Coffee and Necta super-automatics plus professional espresso machines from La Spaziale, Nuova Simonelli, Rancilio, Iberital, Astoria and Fiorenzato; premium roasted coffee from Covim S.p.A. (Italy) and Ukrainian roasting partners; staff training included; 24/7 support. A technician or replacement machine is provided within 24 hours; same-day service is available where operationally possible. Individual quote per client volume, free 14-day trial with no prepayment.

> Languages: the site is bilingual. Ukrainian is the primary language for the native Kyiv market (served under /ua/), with English available at the root for wider reach. Every page has both a Ukrainian and an English version, cross-linked via hreflang (uk / en / x-default→uk).

## Key facts
- Service area: Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast
- Model: individual quote per client volume, Three equipment packages — Start, Pro, Max — matched to the venue format (office, HoReCa, retail); pricing is quoted per venue; free 14-day trial without prepayment; . A technician or replacement machine is provided within 24 hours; same-day service is available where operationally possible. Delivery and installation within 24 hours
- Equipment: Dr. Coffee, Necta (super-automatics); La Spaziale, Nuova Simonelli, Rancilio, Iberital, Astoria, Fiorenzato (professional espresso) — these eight brands are the complete lineup
- Weekly resupply of beans/consumables and weekly technician quality visit; water filtration and maintenance included; online analytics dashboard (cups sold, revenue, stock, errors)
- Premium roasted coffee, not a forced quota: Covim S.p.A. (Italy) and Ukrainian roasting partners, named blends including Bellissima, LOT 101, LOT 105 and Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
- Proven: on the market since 2015, 1,700+ active B2B clients, ~99% repeat clients
